aboutText:
File Space - File Storage Service

Features:

  • Multi-user file management
  • Text file editing with syntax highlighting
  • LaTeX document editing with live preview
  • File upload/download
  • Folder creation and management
  • User quotas and session limits
  • Dark/Light themes
  • Multi-language support
  • Advanced text editor with hotkeys (Ctrl+/ comment, Ctrl+D delete line, etc.)
  • File preview for PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint documents
  • Search within files with navigation
  • Resizable sidebar
  • Drag & drop file upload
  • AI-powered assistant for file analysis and queries
  • Photo editor for images
  • 3D model viewer

Supported file formats:

  • Text files with syntax highlighting (JavaScript, Python, PHP, HTML, CSS, LaTeX, etc.)
  • PDF documents
  • Microsoft Word (.doc, .docx)
  • Microsoft Excel (.xls, .xlsx)
  • Microsoft PowerPoint (.ppt, .pptx)
  • Images (PNG, JPG, GIF, etc.)
  • LaTeX documents (.tex)
  • 3D models (.obj, .stl)
  • And many more...

Hotkeys:

  • Ctrl+S - Save file
  • Ctrl+C - Copy content
  • Ctrl+Shift+A - Open AI Assistant
  • Esc - Close viewer
  • Delete - Delete current file
  • Ctrl+/ - Comment/Uncomment code
  • Ctrl+D - Delete line
  • Ctrl+L - Select line
  • Ctrl+] - Increase indent
  • Ctrl+[ - Decrease indent
  • Ctrl+Shift+F - Search in file
  • Ctrl+Enter - Compile LaTeX (in LaTeX editor)

overviewText: File Space is a comprehensive, multi-user cloud file management and collaboration platform. It provides secure file storage, advanced editing tools, document conversion, AI-powered assistance, real-time synchronization, and support for a wide range of file formats — all accessible through a modern, responsive web interface with customizable themes and multi-language support.
featMultiUser: Multi-user file management with per-user storage quotas and session limits
featTreeNav: Hierarchical folder tree navigation with expand/collapse
featCreateFolders: Create, rename, move, and delete folders
featCreateFiles: Create new text files directly from the interface
featDragDrop: Drag & drop file upload with progress tracking and resume support
featBulkUpload: Bulk file and folder upload (files and directory structures)
featMultiSelect: Multi-select with batch download as ZIP archive
featContextMenu: Context menu with file operations (open, edit, rename, delete, move, copy, share, properties)
featFileMove: Move files and folders between directories with confirmation dialog
featFileSharing: File sharing via shareable links with QR code generation
featRootFolders: Six root workspaces: Folders (main storage), Archive, Temporary Files, Documents (encrypted), Photos, PDF
featEncryptedDocs: AES-encrypted Documents folder — files are encrypted server-side and only accessible by the owner
featMonacoEditor: Monaco Editor (VS Code engine) with syntax highlighting, IntelliSense, code folding, minimap, multi-cursor editing, and find/replace with regex
featCodeMirror: CodeMirror editor as alternative with 25+ language modes (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, PHP, HTML, CSS, SQL, YAML, TOML, Shell, Ruby, Go, Swift, Kotlin, Lua, Perl, R, Vue, Octave, LaTeX, and more)
featTabbedEditing: Tabbed editing — open multiple files simultaneously (up to 10 tabs on desktop, 4 on mobile)
featLatexEditor: Dedicated LaTeX editor with live PDF preview, template library, symbol palette, and document structure insertions (sections, equations, figures, tables, matrices, references)
featMarkdownEditor: Markdown editor with live rendered preview
featPhotoEditor: Photo editor with crop, rotate, draw (brush, shapes, text), filters (grayscale, sepia, invert, vintage, etc.), brightness/contrast/saturation adjustments, and undo
featPdfViewer: Built-in PDF viewer with page navigation, zoom controls, and annotation/drawing tools
featOfficeViewers: Viewers for Microsoft Word (.doc, .docx), Excel (.xls, .xlsx), and PowerPoint (.ppt, .pptx) rendered as HTML
featOnlyOffice: ONLYOFFICE integration for collaborative document editing
featImageViewer: Image viewer with EXIF metadata display (camera model, exposure, GPS coordinates)
featVideoPlayer: Video player (MP4, WebM, OGG, MOV, AVI, MKV) with Plyr controls
featAudioPlayer: Audio player (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, FLAC) with playback controls and waveform visualization
feat3dViewer: 3D model viewer (OBJ, STL, FBX, 3MF, GLTF, GLB, DXF, DWG) powered by Three.js with rotation, zoom, wireframe/solid modes
featZipViewer: ZIP/RAR archive browser with file listing, content preview, and individual file extraction
featTranscriptionEditor: Audio transcription editor — upload audio, get AI-generated text transcript for editing
featCompileRun: Online code compilation and execution for 20+ languages (C, C++, Java, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Swift, Kotlin, JavaScript, TypeScript, Rust, Scala, Perl, Haskell, Lua, R, Octave, and more)
featCompileOutput: Compilation output terminal with stdout/stderr display, execution time, and memory usage
featProgramInput: Program input support for interactive applications
featCodeFormat: Code formatting/beautification for JavaScript, Python, PHP, JSON, HTML, CSS, and more
featCodeActions: Code Actions menu: Format Code, Compress Code, Remove Comments, Fix Problems, Calculate Data
featAIChat: AI-powered chat assistant powered by LLM (Llama, Qwen, or custom model via LM Studio / OpenAI-compatible API)
featAIContext: File-aware AI — sends current file content as context for code explanations, reviews, and suggestions
featAIRoles: Multiple AI roles: General Assistant, Programmer, Search Assistant
featAIActions: Quick actions: Explain Code, Optimize Code, Generate Tests, Code Review, Fix Problems, Calculate Data
featAIReplace: Apply AI-generated code directly to file with "Replace File Content" confirmation
featAIHistory: Persistent chat history stored in SQLite database, loadable with pagination
featAIConfig: Configurable AI endpoint, API key, and model selection via AI Settings panel
featAITokenStreaming: Token-by-token response streaming with typing animation
featQuickSearch: Quick search in the top bar with instant tree filtering
featAdvancedSearch: Advanced Search modal with filters: file name, extension, type (documents/images/audio/video/archives/code/3D), size range, modification date
featInFileSearch: In-file text search with match highlighting and previous/next navigation
featSearchOptions: Search options: match case, whole word, regular expressions
featSearchResults: Search results displayed in a dedicated panel with match count and file paths
featDocConversion: Document conversion: DOCX ↔ HTML, XLSX ↔ HTML, PPTX → HTML (via PhpOffice libraries)
featImageConversion: Image format conversion (PNG, JPG, WEBP, BMP, GIF, etc.) via GD/Imagick
featConvertDialog: Conversion dialog with target format selection, output folder choice, and optional original file deletion
featSyncDesktop: Desktop sync client support — synchronize local folders with File Space storage
featSyncTokens: Token-based authentication for sync clients (180-day expiry, manageable via Settings)
featSyncLog: Sync log viewer — tracks all sync operations (upload, download, delete) with timestamps, status levels (INFO, WARNING, ERROR), and file paths
featSyncConflict: Conflict resolution — server wins if file was modified after the last sync
featSyncSelective: Per-root selective sync — choose which roots to synchronize
featThemes: Dark and Light themes, switchable via URL parameter (?theme=dark/light) or Settings
featAccentColor: Custom accent color selection (?color=#hex or via Settings color picker)
featI18n: Multi-language interface: English, Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian, Polish
featLangSwitcher: Language switcher in the top bar for instant language change
featConstellationBG: Animated constellation background effect on the main page
featEditorSettings: Per-user editor settings: font size, tab size, word wrap, line numbers, auto-completion, auto-save interval
featHideLangSwitcher: Option to hide language switcher on main page (per-user setting)
featQuotas: Per-user storage quotas (MB) and upload session limits (MB)
featUserRole: User role display in Settings (Guest, User, Manager, Admin)
featStorageStats: Storage usage statistics — visual breakdown of space used by each top-level folder with size and file count
featClientAuth: Client auth tokens for API access (device name, platform tracking, 365-day default expiry)
featEncryptedStorage: Server-side AES encryption for Documents root folder
featFileProps: Detailed file properties dialog: name, path, size, type, created/modified/accessed dates, attributes (read-only, hidden), dimensions (for images), EXIF data
featFolderProps: Folder properties: total size (recursive), file count, subfolder count, content listing with size breakdown
